description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402] Balances of an address for APT and fungible assets, all read at ONE ledger version (stated, or the current one pinned). Amounts are exact integer strings plus decimal strings. Default assets: APT and every verified asset; pass `assets` (symbols, ids, addresses, coin types) to choose. An ambiguous symbol fails the whole call. An address with no account and all-zero balances is reported honestly, not as an empty account.

chain.description: Aptos CAIP-2 id: aptos:1 (mainnet, default) or aptos:2 (testnet)

ledgerVersion.description: read the chain exactly as of this ledger version (default: the current one, pinned for consistency)

name: aptos_balance_get
title: Aptos balances at a ledger version
